Description
Experience luxury living in this rarely available and highly sought-after floor plan at the prestigious Pomaria. This beautifully designed furnished 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers 895 sq ft of open-concept living with stunning west and north-facing views of English Bay and the city skyline. Enjoy floor-to-ceiling windows, a spacious view balcony, and high, smooth-finish ceilings. Geothermal heating and cooling provide year-round comfort and energy efficiency. The chef’s kitchen features a five-burner gas cooktop, Sub-Zero fridge, stone countertops, and a large central island. Located in an award-winning architectural landmark, Pomaria offers top-tier amenities and full concierge service. 1 parking stall included.
